messages:
Sam: Heads-up — I pushed the candidate bench results from last night's run. Need to decide 2 models to greenlight for quant experiments next sprint.
Chen: link to results?
Sam: https://internal.redwood/results/2166 — main highlights below.
Ella: skimmed — 3 candidates: aurora-13b, aurora-7b, ember-lite. latency vs quality tradeoffs look interesting.
Ravi: quick note: aurora-13b tops quality but failing some safety evals (hallucination on niche prompts).
Lia: can you paste the small diff benchmark here? makes it easier for PM/infra to decide.
Sam: sure — pasted raw snippet:
```
model         | ppl   | rougeL | avg_latency_ms @batch1
aurora-13b    | 12.4  | 0.72   | 280
aurora-7b     | 14.1  | 0.66   | 120
ember-lite    | 16.8  | 0.58   | 45
```
Chen: thanks. For prioritization, I propose scoring by (quality_weight=0.6, infra_cost=0.3, safety=0.1). Quick math: aurora-13b = 0.6*1 + 0.3*0 + 0.1*0.4 = 0.64; aurora-7b = 0.6*0.8 + 0.3*0.6 + 0.1*0.8 = 0.74; ember-lite = 0.6*0.5 + 0.3*1 + 0.1*1 = 0.65
Lia: interesting — that would put aurora-7b first. But product asked for at least one high-quality candidate for A/B. Can we do 7b + 13b?
Sam: deployment cost for 13b is nontrivial. Dedicated slot would need 4x the 7b. Are we ok with reserved capacity? @infra-bot any quick capacity calc?
infra-bot: Estimated extra GPU hours for aurora-13b in Dedicated during 2-week trial: ~1100 GPU-hrs on A100-80GB. Cost estimate: ~$72k (list).
Ravi: that's high. Could we quantize 13b to int8/q4b to fit cheaper infra? Has anyone run the q-configs?
Ella: I ran lightweight q4bSG on a 1k prompt subset — quality drop ~3% relative to float16 on our main eval, hallucination cases slightly reduced but not eliminated. latency improved ~30%.
Chen: proposal: greenlight aurora-7b for full quant experiments + ember-lite for latency-focused workloads. Put aurora-13b into "candidate - gated" pending SOC/security review and deeper eval on hallucination prompts.
Lia: aligns with roadmap — we promised a mid-tier high-quality model and a low-latency option this quarter. I'll mark this as "sprint-accept: 7b, ember-lite" in the intake board.
Sam: ok. Action items:
- @Chen run full quant sweep for aurora-7b (q4b, int8, GPTQ quick pass) and post results by Tue EOD.
- @Ella expand q4bSG test for aurora-13b to 5k prompts and include safety perturbations.
- @Ravi scope infra options for a 2-week canary of aurora-13b if we get SOC sign-off.
- @Lia update roadmap card and notify product.
Chen: noted. I'll create the PRD checklist and add the eval harness links.
Ella: added test plan to the doc.
Ravi: starting infra estimate now.
Sam: thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll move this thread to the intake board and schedule a 15m sync next Monday. :thumbsup:
Lia: +1
Chen: +1
infra-bot: label updated: intake_status=staged
